input.text: This sprint we cut checkout from five steps to two, added Apple Pay, and saw abandoned carts drop from 31% to 18% in the first week.

Standup notes: Priya is blocked on the Stripe webhook signature check. Marcus finished the onboarding email. Demo dry run moves to Thursday at 3pm. We still need a fallback screen for when the model is slow.
The library extends weekend hours to 10pm starting in November.

why: Demo step 2: faces are blurred, so before anyone has labeled a hug, two people grabbing each other should raise a possible fight. It is really a false alarm, so it counts against fight precision.
frames: Several people stand in a school gym in a loose group.
Two people step toward each other.
The two people throw their arms around each other.
They hold each other tightly, swaying side to side.
They let go and stand next to each other.

why: Demo step 3: a hug at another camera after the officer marked the first one a false alarm. Should not be flagged.

addLabels.label: false_alarm
addLabels.description: Two people embrace, one wrapping an arm around the other's shoulders and pulling them close, swaying together in the gym. Contact is sustained but there are no strikes or struggle.

frames: People walk across a courtyard with picnic tables.
Two people meet and wrap their arms around each other.
The two people hold the embrace for a moment.
They step apart and keep talking.

why: Demo step 4: a real fight after the hug label. Learning must not hide it.

addLabels.label: false_alarm
addLabels.description: Two people embrace, one wrapping an arm around the other's shoulders and pulling them close, swaying together in the gym. Contact is sustained but there are no strikes or struggle.

frames: A student stands with their back against a dark metal door outside the school.
Another student steps in close and grabs the first student's jacket with both fists.
The second student pushes the first back against the door, holding them by the collar.
The pinned student leans away and turns their head while the other keeps a tight grip.
The second student jerks the pinned student's jacket and leans in closer.
The pinned student is still held against the door by the collar.
A person walks across the cafeteria entrance.
The person's feet slide out from under them on a shiny patch of floor.
The person lands hard on their back.
The person lies on their back on the floor, one arm over their head.
The person is still on the floor, trying to sit up slowly.

why: Matches a seed false alarm: sitting down on purpose to wait.
frames: A person walks to the wall outside a classroom door.
The person slides down the wall slowly and sits on the floor.
The person sits on the floor with their back against the wall, looking at a phone.
The person is still sitting against the wall, looking at the phone.
The person is still sitting calmly against the wall.
Two people stand face to face near the gym doors, close together.
One person shoves the other hard in the chest.
The second person stumbles back, then swings a fist at the first.
Both people grab each other and trade punches.
A small crowd gathers around the two people who are still hitting each other.

why: Faces are blurred, so friendly grappling is reported at moderate confidence until an officer labels it. Counts against fight precision on purpose.
frames: Two people walk together down the hallway, laughing.
One person playfully puts the other in a loose headlock, both laughing.
They push each other lightly, still laughing.
They let go and give each other a high five.
They walk on together side by side.
A person walks slowly down a store aisle, looking left and right.
The person takes two small boxes off the shelf.
The person slides both boxes inside their jacket.
The person zips the jacket and walks toward the front of the store.
The person walks past the checkout registers without stopping and out the exit.
A person stands on a second-floor walkway overlooking the atrium.
The person puts one leg over the walkway railing.
The person is sitting on top of the railing with both legs on the outside, above a long drop.
The person is still on the outside of the railing, holding on with one hand.
Several people walk along a hallway lined with lockers.
One person opens a locker and puts a book inside.
Two people stand and talk near a classroom door.
People continue walking past in both directions.
The hallway is mostly empty.

why: More incidents: a passer-by deliberately knocks a book out of a student's hands.
frames: A person walks down a corridor reading an open book held in both hands.
Another person walks toward them from the far end of the corridor.
As they pass, the second person swings an arm and strikes the book.
The book flies out of the first person's hands and falls to the floor.
The first person bends down to pick up the book while the second person walks away without looking back.

why: More incidents: camera tampering is reported as other.
frames: A security camera is mounted on a wooden pole beside a brick wall in an alley.
A person with a face mask walks toward the pole, looking around.
The person crouches next to the pole and glances back over their shoulder.
The person reaches up and wraps tape around the camera lens.
The person hurries away from the pole.
Several bikes are locked to a rack outside the school entrance.
A person walks up to the rack and looks around.
The person kneels by one bike and cuts its lock with a tool from their bag.
The person pulls the bike out of the rack and drops the cut lock on the ground.
The person rides away quickly on the bike.
